root_cause.text: `tun_xdp_one()` in the TUN/TAP XDP sendmsg path failed to release the page backing `xdp->data` when `build_skb()` returned `NULL`, so the page allocated by `vhost_net_build_xdp()` was leaked because the error was propagated only via a discarded per-buffer return value.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `put_page(virt_to_head_page(xdp->data));` immediately before `ret = -ENOMEM; goto out;` in `tun_xdp_one()`, and the CVE description says that on `build_skb()` failure the function “returns without freeing the page” and that `tun_sendmsg()` “discards the per-buffer error,” causing `vhost_tx_batch()` to take the success path and never free the page.
